name: Glass Sand
author: Brandon
description:
Made with the Sandustry Material Studio.

Adds Glass Sand, a pale solid grain, and glass. Drop Glass Sand on a powered Smelter and it converts 1:1 into glass, which is slightly lighter so it clears the machine instead of jamming it.

Glass Sand has no natural source yet - spawn it with testing tools (e.g. the Matter Gun) or a future update.

enabled.descriptionKey: Turn the mod off without unsubscribing. Recipes can only be withdrawn at load, so switching off leaves them until the next restart.
